reason: Accessibility contrast floor (WCAG 1.4.3 and 1.4.11), cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration stencil-4-45-2-generated-types (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, remain as declared there). No published name is added, renamed or removed: every change is a deliberate effective-value change to already-published component token leaves, together with the descriptions that record it. (1) Placeholder text. The ki-input and ki-textarea placeholder foreground in the rest, hover, focus, readonly and invalid cells (--ki-input-{state}-placeholder-fg, --ki-textarea-{state}-placeholder-fg) moves from ki.text.low-em to ki.text.med-em. A placeholder is not the accessible name, and the old descriptions used that to keep it outside the 4.5:1 text sweep; it is still text a sighted user has to read. On the onmars light field fills the old value measured 2.80:1 at rest, 2.66:1 on hover and 3.13:1 focused (13px text); the new value measures 5.56, 5.28 and 6.22:1 there and 8.71-10.20:1 in onmars dark. material3 already pinned ki.text.med-em on every cell except the textarea readonly one, which it inherited from onmars at 4.33:1 light and now inherits at 8.88:1. Disabled cells are unchanged (exempt under 1.4.3). This is a declared deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, not a transcription. The contrast gate now derives every placeholder cell from the token names and holds it to 4.5:1, so the exemption cannot return unnoticed. (2) Non-text marks painted straight onto the page (WCAG 1.4.11, 3:1 against the page surface in all four theme x scheme crossings). ki-status: --ki-status-neutral-color moves from ki.surface.disabled-high-em to ki.outline.control (2.10 -> 3.69:1 onmars light, 2.78 -> 5.01:1 onmars dark, 4.33:1 unchanged material3 light, 2.89 -> 5.87:1 material3 dark); --ki-status-info-color from ki.surface.info-med-em to ki.surface.info-high-em (2.29 -> 3.51:1 onmars light, 2.17 -> 3.33:1 material3 light; 10.05:1 and 5.30:1 dark); --ki-status-warning-color from ki.surface.warning-med-em to ki.text.warning-high-em (1.92 -> 5.59:1 onmars light, 1.82 -> 5.31:1 material3 light; 13.18:1 onmars dark, 3.33:1 material3 dark, where the theme does not flip the warning ramp) - no warning surface step clears 3:1 on a light page (Warning/600 reads 2.33:1). The success and danger fills already cleared 3:1 and are unchanged. ki-indicator: onmars --ki-indicator-dot-color and --ki-indicator-dot-current-color move from ki.inverse-white.alpha-18 to ki.inverse-white.alpha-48, the first step of the same ramp that clears 3:1 (1.53 -> 3.69:1 light, 1.64 -> 5.01:1 dark); material3 moves the resting dot from ki.inverse-white.alpha-32 to ki.outline.control (2.22 -> 4.33:1 light, 2.89 -> 5.87:1 dark) and the current dot from ki.surface.primary-high-em to ki.surface.inverse-white. material3 draws uniform circles, so color alone marks the current position and spec 024 FR-012 asks 3:1 between the two appearances: no resting fill is 3:1 from both the light page and primary tone 30, while the inverse ink reads 4.61:1 light and 3.17:1 dark against the resting dots. ki-scroller: onmars --ki-scroller-thumb-color moves from ki.inverse-white.alpha-6 to ki.inverse-white.alpha-48 (1.12 -> 3.69:1 light, 1.09 -> 5.01:1 dark); material3 moves it from ki.outline.med-em to ki.outline.control (1.62 -> 4.33:1 light, 1.99 -> 5.87:1 dark). These are declared deviations from the MarsUI bindings (Surface/disabled_high_em, Surface/warning_med_em, Inverse_white/alpha_18 and alpha_6), not transcriptions. The contrast gate now derives every painted mark of ki-status, ki-indicator and ki-scroller from the token names and holds it to 3:1 against the page, and holds a current mark drawn in the resting mark's own box to 3:1 against that resting mark.
